description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers font selection, scale derivation, and DTCG type token authoring. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: icon set selection (iconography), raw design-token authoring without a typography constraint (design-tokens), brand archetype requests that require Stage 2 / Phase B, and general color token work.
